          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'

        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255

        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date

          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner has the same last name and address.

          example: false

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must fall in the range for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit value.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence."
              type: string
              example: "FRA-0007"
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "A stable shared identifier assigned when an owner joins an existing same-lastName household at the same address via sharesHousehold; every member shares one value."
              type: string
              example: "HH-1A2B3C4D"
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The derived duplicate-detection key 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'; two owners collide only when their whole keys match."
              type: string
              example: "+61400000001||"
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year."
              type: string
              example: "SMI-0007-M26"
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric level from 1 to 3: starts at 1, +1 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners have already been registered today, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: "PHONE"
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

All tests pass and the build is green. Here's what I did and why it keeps structural impact low.

## Change
`POST /api/owners` now accepts an optional ISO `birthDate`; `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns `ageBand` derived from it against `registrationDate` — `MINOR` (<18), `ADULT` (18–64), `SENIOR` (65+), and absent when no `birthDate` was supplied.

## Files touched (6)
1. **`openapi.yml`** — added `birthDate` to `OwnerFields` (request) and read-only `ageBand` to `Owner` (response). Regenerates the DTOs.
2. **`model/Owner.java`** — one `birthDate` field + its accessors (persisted `birth_date` column), following the existing derived-column pattern.
3. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — one added `@Mapping` line delegating to the helper; `birthDate` maps by name automatically both ways.
4. **`function/owner/AgeBand.java`** (new) — a small, self-contained helper (`WMC_other` = 0) holding the only branching logic, mirroring the existing `IdentityKey`/`CheckDigit` static-helper idiom.
5. **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** — `birth_date DATE` column (the test DB).
6. **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — trailing `NULL` on the 10 positional seed inserts to match the new column.

## Keeping cost down
- The only real behaviour (age→band branching) lives in a **new tiny class**, not grown into a big one — so it pays `WMC_other = 0` rather than the whole `Owner` or mapper class.
- Every existing function I changed stays trivial: the mapper edit is a single annotation line (interface method, CC 1); the `Owner` additions are plain accessors.
- No new endpoint YAML/functions were needed — the derivation rides the existing pipeline and mapper, so the POST/GET orchestration is untouched.

The default runtime profile (h2) needs no DB edits: it uses `ddl-auto=update` (Hibernate adds the column) and named-column inserts. hsqldb (used by tests) needed the positional-insert fix, which I applied. I left postgres/mysql schemas alone since they're outside the test and default-runtime paths.
